exceptions.reason: False positive in mobsfscan 0.4.5: its source-manifest parser defaults an absent target SDK to 26 instead of reading Gradle. Gradle and the merged debug/release manifests specify minSdk 30 and targetSdk 37. Android 11 and newer include the StrandHogg platform fixes. Preserve the existing singleTop notification navigation.
